findings.note: A RotoWire update dated Oct 25, 2026 says Parekh had 18 shots on goal so far this season, scored a power-play goal on two shots against Detroit, and gets all his points on the power play, while still playing third-pair minutes.
An Oct 18, 2026 update says Parekh plays on the first power-play unit despite his third-pair even-strength role, with 14 shots in 8 games. That is about 1.75 per game, above the 1.5 line.

Notes from his 2025-26 rookie season show only 36 shots in 32 games (about 1.1 per game) in sheltered third-pair minutes, with a recent injury history. Nothing dated close to Nov 2, 2026 confirms his status for this game.
